review_findings.issue: Waiting pending-pause animations on finished may never settle
review_findings.resolution: Final filter selects playState running and finite endTime; pending play remains running; pending pause is excluded

reviewed_evidence.scope: Actual React ApplicationShell/useContentScroll/CollectionForm, global CSS and CSS Modules; synthetic adapters for Next/router/auth, Arial fallback
reviewed_evidence.limitation: One-frame result is supplemented by the stronger independent ResizeObserver fixture below; not sufficient alone

reviewed_evidence.result: 3/3 PASS; two frames after animation settling

causal_assessment: Global finite .3s transitions continue resizing observed shell content; ResizeObserver schedules revealFocus in the following rAF and can scroll the active input after the target scroll. Waiting all finite running animation generations, then draining two rAF callbacks and rechecking, places the existing single target scroll after that work. No assertion or product focus behavior is changed.
limitations: Auxiliary Linux Chromium execution does not replace official Windows/PostgreSQL gates for a new commit.
This review verifies helper timing and continued rejection of obstructions; evidence durability and full application viewport inspection are separately owned by the environmental QA agent.
